title: Frequently Asked Questions
metaTitle: Pixovo Help Center | FAQ & Customer Support
metaDescription: Find answers about ordering, uploading photos, sizing, and shipping or contact Pixovo support directly for help

items.q: What is Pixovo?
items.a: Pixovo is an AI-powered photo book company that turns your uploaded photos into a professionally designed, premium printed photo book automatically — you upload, the AI designs the layout, and we print and ship it from the USA. Learn more about us.

items.q: Is Pixovo made in the USA?
items.a: Yes. Every Pixovo photo book is printed and shipped from the USA using premium materials. Read more about our quality standards.

items.q: How is Pixovo different from other photo book makers like Shutterfly or Mixbook?
items.a: Pixovo is built around AI-first design — you upload your photos and the AI designs the whole layout automatically, rather than asking you to build every page manually from a template. See our blog for guides on how the process compares to manual photo book tools.

items.q: Is my photo data safe and private with Pixovo?
items.a: Yes — photos you upload are used only to create your order and are handled according to our Privacy Policy.

items.q: How do I create a photo book with Pixovo?
items.a: Upload your photos, let Pixovo's AI design the layout automatically, then customize anything you like and place your order. Most people finish in a few minutes. See our How It Works page for the full walkthrough.

items.q: How does Pixovo's AI design my photo book automatically?
items.a: Pixovo's AI analyzes your uploaded photos and automatically arranges, sizes, and styles every page into a complete layout, so you start from a finished draft instead of a blank page. Read the deeper breakdown in What Is an AI Photo Book Maker?

items.q: Can I customize or edit what the AI creates?
items.a: Yes. The AI-generated layout is a starting point — you can swap photos, change layouts, edit captions, and personalize the cover before ordering. See How It Works.

items.q: Do I need any design experience to use Pixovo?
items.a:
No. The AI handles the design work, so anyone can create a
                            professional-looking photo book with no design or software experience needed.

items.q: How many photos do I need to upload for a photo book?
items.a: There's no strict minimum or maximum — as a general guide, a standard 20-page book comfortably fits roughly 40–60 photos (about 2–3 per spread), scaling up if you add extra pages. See Pricing for page-count options, or our step-by-step guide for more detail.

items.q: How much does a Pixovo photo book cost?
items.a: Pricing starts at $19.99 for an 8×8 Small Photobook, $19.99 for the 10×10 Standard Photobook (our most popular size), and $39.99 for a 12×12 Large Photobook — each starting price includes 20 premium pages. See full details on the Pricing page.

items.q: What factors affect the price of my photo book?
items.a: Price depends mainly on size, cover type (softcover or hardcover), and total page count — extra pages beyond the standard 20 can be added for a small per-page fee. See Pricing for the full breakdown.

items.q: Does Pixovo offer a discount for first-time orders?
items.a: There's no standing first-order discount code published on the site right now. Designing your book is always free, so there's no cost until you actually order — check the Pricing page or checkout for any current promotions.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for bulk or multiple copies?
items.a: There's no separate published bulk-discount tier at the moment — additional copies of a book you've designed can be reordered at the standard per-book price. For larger group orders, contact support to ask about options.

items.q: What photo book sizes does Pixovo offer?
items.a: Pixovo offers three square sizes: 8×8 (Small), 10×10 (Standard, our most popular), and 12×12 (Large) — each available in softcover or hardcover. See Pricing for details.

items.q: What's the difference between softcover and hardcover photo books?
items.a: Softcover keeps things lightweight and affordable, while hardcover adds a more durable, display-ready cover — every book also includes layflat-style page spreads, so two-page photos open without a crease down the middle. See Pricing for upgrade costs.

items.q: Which size is best for a wedding, travel, or baby photo book?
items.a: Larger formats (10×10 or 12×12) tend to suit weddings and coffee-table display books, while the 8×8 size works well for travel and everyday books. Browse Pricing to compare sizes, or check the blog for occasion-specific guides.

items.q: How long does shipping take?
items.a: Standard delivery typically takes 5–10 working days, including printing and quality checks. Express shipping is available at checkout and arrives in about 3–6 working days. Timelines may shift slightly during peak seasons — see Shipping Info for details.

items.q: Does Pixovo ship internationally?
items.a: Not yet — Pixovo currently ships across the USA (including select remote locations depending on courier availability). International shipping isn't available yet, but it's coming. See Shipping Info for the latest.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive tracking information by email (with status updates from dispatched through delivered). For help finding it, reach out through our contact page.

items.q: What print quality and materials does Pixovo use?
items.a: Pixovo photo books are printed in the USA on premium 100gsm silk paper with vibrant, fade-resistant inks, and every copy is quality-checked before it ships. See About Us for more.

items.q: How durable are Pixovo photo books?
items.a:
Pixovo books are built with quality binding and premium paper so they hold up
                            to years of being handled and revisited, not just a one-time flip-through.

items.q: Can I make a travel photo book with Pixovo?
items.a: Yes — upload your trip photos and Pixovo's AI will design a travel photo book for you, organized and styled automatically. Start creating.

items.q: Can I create a wedding photo book or album?
items.a: Yes — Pixovo can turn wedding photos from multiple sources into a premium wedding album, AI-designed and ready to customize. Start creating.

items.q: Can I make a baby's first year photo book?
items.a: Yes — upload a year of photos and Pixovo's AI can help organize them into a keepsake baby milestone book. Start creating.

items.q: Are Pixovo photo books a good gift idea?
items.a: Yes — a photo book holds many photos and tends to get revisited repeatedly, which makes it a popular choice for anniversaries, new babies, and holidays compared to single-photo gifts like mugs or frames. See our blog for gifting ideas.

items.q: Can I make changes to my photo book after I order it?
items.a: Yes, within a short window — changes or cancellations can be requested within 1 hour of placing your order, since production begins shortly after. Contact support right away if you need to make a change.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with my finished photo book?
items.a: Pixovo backs every order with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If your book arrives damaged or something's wrong, send a photo within 14 days of delivery and we'll reprint or refund it at no cost. See our Help Center for details.

items.q: How do I contact Pixovo customer support?
items.a: You can reach the Pixovo team through the contact page, and Pixie (the on-site AI assistant) can also answer common questions instantly.

items.q: Can I reorder or print extra copies of a photo book I already made?
items.a: Yes — once your book is designed, you can order additional printed copies of the same book without redesigning it. Start creating.

items.q: Do I need to create an account to make a photo book?
items.a: No account is required to design your book — you can create and preview it for free. At checkout you can order as a guest, though creating an account lets you save designs, reorder in one click, and track past orders in one place. Start creating.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Simply upload your photos, choose your book size and style, customize your layout, then checkout. It takes just a few minutes!

items.q: Can I reorder a previous photobook?
items.a: Yes! Log into your account, go to your order history, and click "Reorder" on any previous photobook. Your design is saved automatically.

items.q: Can I make changes after placing the order?
items.a: Changes can be made within 1 hour of placing your order. Please contact our support team immediately at support@pixovo.com.

items.q: How long does delivery take?
items.a: Standard delivery takes 7–10 business days. Express shipping (3–5 days) is available at checkout for an additional fee.

items.q: Do you offer express shipping?
items.a: Yes! Express shipping is available at checkout. Select "Express" during the shipping step to receive your photobook in 3–5 business days.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order in your Pixovo account under "My Orders".

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

items.q: Is my payment information secure?
items.a: Absolutely. All payments are processed through 256-bit SSL encryption. We never store your full card details on our servers.

items.q: What if my photobook arrives damaged?
items.a: We're sorry to hear that! Please email us a photo of the damage within 14 days of delivery. We'll reprint or refund your order at no cost.

items.q: Can I cancel my order?
items.a: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of purchase. After that, production begins and cancellations are no longer possible. Contact support immediately.

items.q: Do I need an account to place an order?
items.a: You can check out as a guest, but creating an account lets you save designs, reorder easily, and track all your orders in one place.

items.q: I've forgotten my password. How do I reset it?
items.a: Click "Sign In" then "Forgot Password". Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

items.q: What sizes and formats are available?
items.a: We offer Small (8×8 in), Standard (10×10 in), and Large (12×12 in) photobooks in both portrait and landscape orientations.

items.q: What print quality can I expect?
items.a: We use professional-grade printing on 100gsm silk paper with vibrant, fade-resistant inks. Every book is inspected before shipping to ensure premium quality.

photobookFaq.q: Is Pixovo really free to try?
photobookFaq.a: Yes — you can design your full photo book for free and only pay when you order the printed copy.

photobookFaq.q: What occasions can I make a photo book for?
photobookFaq.a: Travel, weddings, baby and family milestones, and gifts all have dedicated flows, or you can start from scratch for anything else.
